en.title: Resume

points: Coursework: Marketing Management, Economics and Business Mathematics, Business Statistics, Organizational Behaviour, International Business, Business Communication, Operations Management.

New-product research and messaging: Supported ZUS Coffee pre-launch research using target-user preferences, social engagement and competitor content. Organized product benefits and consumption scenarios to inform launch topics, promotional assets and channel promotion.
Social content execution: Assisted with 50 Instagram posts, including topic planning, shooting, editing, English copywriting, hashtags and asset organization.

Channel and data reviews: Supported online launches and FamilyMart retail communication by organizing promotional assets, store information and publishing schedules. Tracked data weekly and produced 15+ content reviews to guide subsequent improvements; contributed to overall account follower growth of 11k+.

Customer needs and records: Engaged with university users and organized 100+ feedback items into a needs log by teaching, lesson preparation and self-study scenarios and issue type. Identified recurring needs and usage barriers to support customer communication, pilot promotion and product improvements.

Partnership coordination: Supported Southeast Asia AI education partnerships by clarifying needs, responsibilities and open questions, organizing communication materials and sharing project progress. Followed up on agreement signing and handoff to support coordination between partners and internal teams.

Content and feature adoption: Built the product WeChat content program from scratch, turning product functions into user-scenario content across 30+ guides, FAQs, tutorials and cases. Created reusable product introductions and support materials; core-feature usage increased 30% during the period.

University promotion and execution: Coordinated university presentations, product trials and on-site questions, and worked with product and business teams on demonstrations, teaching cases and course materials. Followed up on event arrangements and execution issues, and proposed 10 improvements from user behaviour and teacher/student feedback to support future pilots.
Coursework: Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behaviour, Marketing Research, Customer Analytics and CRM, B2B Marketing, New Product Marketing.
AI dashboard: Built an AI-assisted operations dashboard to compare conversion performance and identify drop-off points.

Creator screening: Screened finance and AI creators against product positioning and target audiences using audience profiles, content relevance and engagement. Organized account details, content characteristics and partnership fit in a creator resource sheet to support outreach and selection.

Partnership communication and content support: Assisted with creator content requirements and publishing arrangements, organized product information, assets and milestones, and followed up on missing materials and execution progress. Distilled messages from user feedback and pricing surveys and delivered 100+ WeChat, Xiaohongshu and community posts.

Channel promotion and performance review: Supported online acquisition and offline technology-event promotion, compared channel performance through title, cover and content A/B tests, and prepared periodic reviews to support budget adjustments. Campaign-period registrations rose 50% versus the previous week; the first-topic creation rate increased approximately 15% relatively.

skills: Profile: Working English; experience in business analysis, creator screening, channel promotion and partnership coordination, with an interest in FMCG and community commerce operations.
Operations: Metric tracking, needs organization, creator collaboration, project coordination, customer records and performance reviews.
AI and productivity: AI-assisted copy ideation, content concepts, operations dashboards and data analysis; SOPs, execution checklists and reusable templates.
Data and reporting: Excel (common formulas and pivot tables), PowerPoint, SPSS, SQL (basic).
Platforms and content tools: Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Instagram, WeChat; Canva, CapCut, Figma (basic).
